checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Large shocked human face on right
must.why: Close-up gamer with wide eyes, open mouth, hands on cheeks, headset.

must.item: Headline exactly ONE LAST TRY, no extra words
must.why: Three words, one per line, spelled correctly.

must.item: Headline on left, high contrast, not covering face
must.why: Yellow/white with black outline on blue; slight tight edge near the face but no overlap.

faults.what: Low resolution (640px wide), soft at full size
Slightly blurry dark objects in the bottom-left corner background
TRY text sits close to the hand/face area

summary: A bright, punchy thumbnail with correctly spelled chunky headline on the left and a convincing shocked headset gamer on the right, only held back by low resolution.
